entry.title: Consultation conclusions on tightening limits on misleading names used by unregulated entities
entry.summary: SFC concludes consultation on further restricting use of misleading names by unregulated entities to protect investors SFC · Nov 6, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「a similar provision under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (AMLO)」 The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong published the conclusions of its consultation on restricting unregulated entities from adopting names that may falsely suggest regulated status. Respondents broadly supported expanding the restricted titles list under the Securities and Futures Ordinance and adding a similar provision to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance. The SFC agreed to a faster list-update mechanism and plans to introduce an amendment bill to the Legislative Council.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong at PWMA Wealth Management Summit 2026: When information is abundant, judgment becomes scarce
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Keynote speech at PWMA Wealth Management Industry Summit 2026 SFC · Nov 5, 2026 · SpeechIn a keynote speech at the Private Wealth Management Association's 2026 summit, SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong argues that AI is making information abundant, so judgment, accountability and trust become the scarce assets. He says future wealth managers will act as conductors of technology while focusing human effort on complex decisions and relationships. The speech also highlights Hong Kong's opportunities as a cross-border wealth hub.

entry.title: Global investment summit closes with forum on conversations with global investors
entry.summary: Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit concludes with “Conversations with Global Investors” investment forum SFC · Nov 4, 2026 · ReportThe Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Securities and Futures Commission and Hong Kong Academy of Finance co-organised a forum on 4 November 2026 to conclude the three-day Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit 2026. More than 300 leaders from financial markets, commercial and public sectors discussed key issues shaping the future of global financial markets. Over 20 global investors shared views on topics including changes in asset and wealth management, Asia’s investment horizons and the role of artificial intelligence in portfolio management and risk assessment. entry.title: SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong's welcome remarks at a 2026 investment summit forum, 'Beyond the Familiar: A Fresh Look at Asia'
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Welcome remarks at “Conversations with Global Investors” forum of 2026 Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit SFC · Nov 4, 2026 · SpeechHong Kong SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong gave welcome remarks at the "Conversations with Global Investors" forum of the 2026 Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit. He argues that Asia's markets, with different cycles, valuations and growth drivers, offer sources of alpha for active investors. The speech also says active investors can help build better companies through capital discipline and accountability, and that Hong Kong should be a marketplace where global capital engages with Asia, not just a gateway.

entry.title: HKMA extends Project Ensemble pilot to 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposits
entry.summary: HKMA advances Project Ensemble pilot phase to 24/7 settlement in tokenised Central Bank Money HKMA · Nov 2, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「support the interbank settlement of tokenised deposit transactions in tokenised Central Bank Money (CeBM) on a 24/7 basis」 The HKMA announced that EnsembleTX, the pilot phase of Project Ensemble, now supports 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposit transactions in tokenised Central Bank Money. Participating banks rose to 12 and industry pioneers to 20. The capability lets participants settle tokenised transactions beyond conventional operating hours.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Executive Director Elisa Ng: scaling tokenisation in Hong Kong's capital markets
entry.summary: New speech by Elisa Ng: Keynote at Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 SFC · Nov 2, 2026 · Speech · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Tokenisation involves the use of blockchain-based tokens to represent ownership of assets.」 Elisa Ng, the SFC's Executive Director of Investment Products, gave a keynote at Hong Kong FinTech Week on 2 November 2026. She said Hong Kong has built the groundwork for tokenisation and now has 17 tokenised retail products. She highlighted secondary trading of tokenised money market funds and treasury management linking tokenised funds with digital money. She also introduced an "innovation pathway" to provide regulatory flexibility for controlled pilots. entry.title: Synopsis of Julia Leung's panel remarks at Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 on responsible innovation through AI and tokenisation
entry.summary: New synopsis by Julia Leung: Panel remarks at Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 SFC · Nov 2, 2026 · SpeechSFC Chief Executive Julia Leung spoke at a panel during Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 on AI, especially agentic AI, cybersecurity and securities tokenisation. The SFC plans principles-based guidance for AI applications with greater autonomy and a cybersecurity framework for licensed firms, with enhanced requirements for higher-risk firms. She also reviewed progress in tokenising investment products.

entry.title: SFC survey shows wider AI use and challenges to responsible scaling
entry.summary: SFC survey highlights wider AI adoption and challenges to responsible scaling SFC · Nov 2, 2026 · ReportThe Hong Kong SFC published its first Large Firm AI Readiness Survey, covering 20 large financial firms with 78 affiliated licensed corporations, conducted in July and August 2026. It finds 30% of firms already use agentic AI and 25% are piloting it, and most expect AI use to accelerate over 12 months. The report also lists barriers such as technology integration, moving pilots to production, costs, data and skills, and sets out four supervisory priorities. entry.title: HKMA announces new fintech initiatives on agentic finance, post-quantum cryptography, tokenised settlement and cross-border payments
entry.summary: Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 HKMA · Nov 2, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The HKMA has also completed trial trades involving Recognised Dealers conducting secondary market transactions of tokenised Exchange Fund Bills, enabling them to enhance efficiency in secondary and re」 The HKMA co-organised the 11th Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 with Invest Hong Kong on 2 November 2026. It announced initiatives including Project SAGE on agentic finance governance, a PQC Toolkit to help banks transition to post-quantum cryptography, 24/7 settlement of tokenised transactions under EnsembleTX, and a link between the Faster Payment System and UnionPay International for QR code payments.

entry.title: SFC welcomes HKEX expansion of China bonds as margin collateral
entry.summary: SFC welcomes expanded use of China Government Bonds as margin collateral by HKEX SFC · Nov 2, 2026 · GuidanceHKEX's two clearing houses now accept China Government Bonds and China policy bank bonds as eligible non-cash margin collateral, effective today. They have also cut accommodation charges on non-cash collateral to 0.15% per annum. The SFC says the move lowers market participants' funding costs and supports Hong Kong's fixed income and currency ecosystem.

entry.title: SFC welcomes appointments to the Process Review Panel, a body that reviews its case handling
entry.summary: SFC welcomes appointments to Process Review Panel SFC · Oct 30, 2026 · PersonnelThe Hong Kong SFC welcomes the re-appointment of the Chairman and 10 incumbent members, and the appointment of two new members, to its Process Review Panel for two years from 1 November 2026. The panel is an independent body that reviews SFC case handling and advises on internal procedures and operational guidelines.

entry.title: Freezing orders on Lo Kai Bong and Major Success lifted after HK$146.9 million paid into Court in SFC case
entry.summary: Freezing orders against Lo Kai Bong and Major Success lifted in SFC’s proceedings following payment of $146.9 million into Court SFC · Oct 30, 2026 · EnforcementHong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has lifted the worldwide freezing orders against Lo Kai Bong and Major Success Group Limited after they paid HK$146,859,320 into Court on 20 October 2026, matching the frozen amount. The SFC's section 214 proceedings against Lo, LET Group Holdings and Summit Ascent Holdings seek remedies including a share repurchase order and appointment of a receiver or manager. The sum will be available to meet any orders the Court makes at the end of the case, with trial scheduled to begin on 20 September 2027.

entry.title: Keynote speech by Kelvin Wong at HKSA's 47th Anniversary Financial Innovation Forum on human-centric technology governance
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Keynote speech at HKSA’s 47th Anniversary Financial Innovation Forum SFC · Oct 30, 2026 · SpeechSFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong delivered a keynote speech at the Hong Kong Securities Association's 47th Anniversary Financial Innovation Forum, titled in Chinese as "Human-centric Technology Governance Empowers Sustainable Development for Securities Industry" (Chinese version only). He argues that the financial industry needs "Accountable Intelligence" and outlines three points for AI governance: visibility, controllability and explainability. The speech stresses that good governance supports rather than opposes innovation.

entry.title: SFC confirms upgrades to Hong Kong's retail fund rules
entry.summary: SFC to proceed with enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime code SFC · Oct 8, 2026 · GuidanceThe Securities and Futures Commission has published its consultation conclusions on amendments to the Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds, taking effect in November 2026. The changes add a Value-at-Risk approach for managing retail funds' derivative exposure, streamline requirements for management companies and feeder funds, and strengthen liquidity risk management and money market fund safeguards. Related codes for pooled retirement funds, MPF products, investment-linked assurance schemes and REITs will be amended in parallel, with a 12-month transition for existing funds. Correction Oct 30, 2026: Document type changed from "Rule" to "Guidance"

entry.title: Regulator approves first secondary trading of tokenised public funds in Hong Kong
entry.summary: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds SFC · Oct 26, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has approved the world’s first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform (VATP).」 The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on a licensed virtual asset trading platform. Two authorised tokenised money market funds can now be traded around the clock. The SFC's April 2026 circular set out requirements covering trading operations, fair pricing, liquidity provision and disclosure. Correction Oct 30, 2026: Document type changed from "Rule" to "Guidance"

entry.title: SFC issues guidance to help the fund industry prepare for revised retail fund code
entry.summary: SFC issues guidance to support enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime SFC · Oct 28, 2026 · GuidanceThe Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong published guidance to help fund managers prepare for the revised Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds, which takes effect on 1 November 2026. The guidance includes circulars, FAQs and updated guides covering new fund authorisations, derivatives using the Value-at-Risk approach, liquidity risk management and money market fund requirements. Revised key facts statement templates were also published.

entry.title: SFC welcomes launch of platform and nominee services on fund platform
entry.summary: SFC welcomes launch of Platform and Nominee Services on Integrated Fund Platform SFC · Oct 28, 2026 · GuidanceThe SFC welcomes HKEX's launch of Platform and Nominee Services on the Integrated Fund Platform (IFP). The new services let fund managers and distributors streamline operations and broaden participation in fund distribution. Fund subscriptions and redemptions by distributors, including brokers acting for their clients, became operational from the date of the announcement.

entry.title: SFC chairman's keynote on sharpening investor judgement against digital fraud at IOSCO World Investor Week 2026
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Keynote Remarks at IOSCO World Investor Week 2026 - Strike the Gong for Financial Literacy Event SFC · Oct 14, 2026 · SpeechSFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong gave a keynote speech at the IOSCO World Investor Week 2026 financial literacy event. He argued that social media and artificial intelligence make investment fraud harder to spot, and that education and experience do not necessarily prevent it. He proposed three habits to strengthen judgement: practise, pause and question, and said regulators, financial institutions and technology platforms also share responsibility for investor protection.

entry.title: Hong Kong SFC approves six securities registrars for the new uncertificated securities regime
entry.summary: SFC approves six securities registrars for upcoming uncertificated securities market regime SFC · Oct 13, 2026 · LicensingThe SFC approved six companies as approved securities registrars effective 16 November 2026, when the uncertificated securities market regime takes effect. Two of them are approved to provide USM-related services, and other applications will be reviewed later. Listed issuers must keep an approved registrar at all times, and existing issuers must join the regime within five years.

entry.title: SFC to strengthen targeted tools against IPO-related and other corporate misconduct
entry.summary: SFC proceeds to strengthen targeted tools to tackle IPO-related and other corporate misconduct SFC · Oct 13, 2026 · GuidanceThe Securities and Futures Commission has published its consultation conclusions on strengthening targeted tools under the Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) Rules for IPO cases and post-IPO matters. The proposals received broad market support and are expected to take effect in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the legislative process. The amendments allow conditions on listing applicants that continue after listing, post-listing conditions as an alternative to immediate trading suspension, streamlined resumption procedures, and independent merits review through the Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal."}}
